groupings.title: Create add-on content
groupings.description: Create and change mobs, items, and blocks for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition add-ons, from a plain description to working behavior and resource pack files. Works with the Minecraft Creator Tools MCP server (npx -y @minecraft/creator-tools@latest mcp).

groupings.title: Models and textures
groupings.description: Design 3D models and textures for mobs, and draw pixel-art item icons and block textures, with previews to check the result.

groupings.title: Validate and ship
groupings.description: Find and fix add-on problems, explain Content Log errors, package a .mcaddon, and run any Minecraft Creator Tools (mct) command.
